description: This file defines an interface for building FeatureDefinition objects in a mutable, fluent manner. It provides methods to add, remove, retrieve, and stream identifiers, as well as to construct an immutable FeatureDefinition instance.

classes.name: FeatureDefinitionBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder with a fluent API for an immutable FeatureDefinition.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds the specified identifier to the builder if not already present.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds all identifiers from the provided iterable to the builder.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the specified identifier from the builder if present.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all identifiers contained in the provided iterable from the builder.

methods.name: getFirstIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the first identifier in the builder or null if none.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the count of identifiers in the builder.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a Stream of the identifiers.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates an immutable FeatureDefinition containing the current identifiers.
